LP/QP suggestions never authorize separation: all accepted fine pairs have an independently recomputed separating projection bound. AABB pruning also supplies a recomputed geometric lower bound.
Reported per-stage minimum is the smallest certified lower bound across all pairs, not an exact global Euclidean closest-distance calculation.

A descent-prefix boundary, if selected, is a height condition and does not establish crossing the actual open mouth or containment.
